name: Webhook Runner
description: Send, save, inspect, and reproduce HTTP webhook requests with optional secure authorization.
author: Vehla

commands.title: Compose Webhook Request
commands.subtitle: Use a native form and inspect a structured response

form.title: Webhook Request Builder
form.description: Build a request without compact palette syntax. Form values are used only for this invocation.

fields.label: Request body
fields.description: JSON is validated when Content-Type is application/json.

fields.label: One-time Authorization override
fields.description: Optional complete header value. It is never saved and overrides the configured secret.

commands.title: Send Webhook
commands.subtitle: Use METHOD URL | JSON body | Header: value; ...

commands.title: Save Webhook
commands.subtitle: Use name | METHOD URL | JSON body | headers

commands.title: Run Saved Webhook
commands.subtitle: Run a saved request by name

commands.title: List Saved Webhooks
commands.subtitle: Copy a summary of saved requests

commands.title: Delete Saved Webhook
commands.subtitle: Delete a saved request by name

commands.title: Generate cURL Command
commands.subtitle: Convert request syntax into a shell-safe cURL command

secrets.label: Authorization Header
secrets.description: Optional full Authorization value, such as Bearer <token>. It is injected only when a request does not provide its own Authorization header.
